therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: gemcitabine inhibits DNA synthesis, paclitaxel stabilizes microtubules preventing cell division
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients aged 70 and older with advanced or recurrent cancer of the urinary tract
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: feasibility of accruing patients with metastatic bladder cancer who are 70 and older to chemotherapy protocols

results.effect_size: 55 patients accrued (target was 60), 22% overall response rate (95% CI: 11-35%)

context.duration: 66 months accrual period (July 2001 to December 2006), treatment up to 19 weeks
context.investigator_commentary: Trial was terminated early, failing to meet accrual target of 60 elderly patients (only 55 accrued). Accrual rate did not meet the feasibility threshold of 3 patients per month after startup period.
